children.name: Title · A · One "now" button, only while something happens

children.text: A · One "now" button, only while something happens

Downloads and media merge into a single button that appears only while a download runs or a tab plays sound: a ring for progress, sound bars for media, both in one. Click it for one small panel (now playing on top, downloads below). Idle, the row ends at the puzzle and a horizontal ⋯ menu.

children.name: Title · B · Inside the address bar

children.text: The address field carries the activity at its end, as small marks: sound bars while a tab plays, a ring while something downloads. Click either for the same panel as A. The rest of the row is fixed: ← address → puzzle ⋯.

children.name: Title · C · The menu button carries it

children.text: C · The menu button carries it

One round button ends the row: the Mast sails, which open the menu. A download draws its progress as a ring around it; a playing tab adds a small sound mark on it. The menu opens with now playing and downloads at the top, then the usual items.
